fields.name: count
fields.desc: number of records

desc: Items: weapons, armor, accessories and consumables (1364 rows x 1120 bytes). Price and 8 stat bonuses are 64-bit. Key 'id' is used by shop/drop/delivery/exchange tables. unique_innocent -> HABIT.dat id, use_skill -> magic.dat id, weapon_anm -> anm file. Rows 0..~1130 are equipment in order fist, sword, spear, bow, gun, axe, staff, monster, armor, belt, shoes, orb, glasses, muscle, emblem; each normal series is followed by its +10000 high-rank copy.

fields.name: price
fields.desc: shop price in HL (u64; e.g. Thimble 80, Ultimus 300,000,000)

fields.name: HP
fields.desc: base HP bonus of the item (signed 64-bit; axes have negative HIT/SPD)

fields.name: SP
fields.desc: base SP bonus of the item (signed 64-bit; axes have negative HIT/SPD)

fields.name: ATK
fields.desc: base ATK bonus of the item (signed 64-bit; axes have negative HIT/SPD)

fields.name: DEF
fields.desc: base DEF bonus of the item (signed 64-bit; axes have negative HIT/SPD)

fields.name: INT
fields.desc: base INT bonus of the item (signed 64-bit; axes have negative HIT/SPD)

fields.name: RES
fields.desc: base RES bonus of the item (signed 64-bit; axes have negative HIT/SPD)

fields.name: HIT
fields.desc: base HIT bonus of the item (signed 64-bit; axes have negative HIT/SPD)

fields.name: SPD
fields.desc: base SPD bonus of the item (signed 64-bit; axes have negative HIT/SPD)

fields.name: id
fields.desc: item id (unique; weapons 101..,  +10000 = high-rank copies, armor 901.., consumables 2001.., DLC 5101..). Referenced by shops/drops/deliveries

fields.name: icon
fields.desc: menu icon id (0 fist,1 sword,2 spear,3 bow,4 gun,5 axe,6 staff,7 monster, 13 monster-spear, 21 medal, 29 orb, 61 muscle, 96 attack item, 160 chara-world item ...)

fields.name: category
fields.desc: item sub-category shown in menus/sorting

fields.name: MOV
fields.desc: movement bonus (shoes 1..4, Baal gear 1)

fields.name: CNT
fields.desc: counter bonus (fists 1..2)

fields.name: unique_innocent
fields.desc: innocent (resident) always attached to the item, 0 = none. Values are HABIT.dat ids (247 Burner on fire weapons, 248 Blower wind, 249 Freezer ice, 250 Revenge Booster, 201.. gag weapons e.g. TV->45 Degree Angler)

fields.name: weapon_anm
fields.desc: weapon model/sprite file (anmNNNNN.dat); 0 = no weapon graphic (armor/items). 415 of 416 values exist in ANM_HI_JP

fields.name: not_in_shop
fields.desc: 1 = not sold in the shop (all +10000 high-rank items, rare/special items); 0 = normal shop stock

fields.name: pad_441
fields.desc: always 0

fields.name: rank
fields.desc: item rank (1..40 normal series, 101..140 for the +10000 high-rank copies; char-exclusive items 39, DLC 10). Price/stats grow with it

fields.name: pad_447
fields.desc: always 0

fields.name: RNG
fields.desc: attack range (fist/sword/axe 1, spear 2, bow 4-6, gun 5-7, staff 2-3); for usable items the use range

fields.name: JMP
fields.desc: jump bonus (shoes 2..34, Baal gear 12)

fields.name: pad_44A
fields.desc: always 0

fields.name: CRT
fields.desc: critical rate % (weapons 2..30)

fields.name: weapon_param_44C
fields.desc: per-weapon-type constant: fist/sword/spear/bow/monster 5, gun 3, axe 30, staff 10 (some special weapons deviate); 0 for non-weapons. Meaning unknown (damage variance? mastery?)

fields.name: use_skill
fields.desc: magic.dat id executed when the item is used: attack items 960..983 ('(Item Skill)'), steal hands 5 (Steal); 0 = none

fields.name: item_group
fields.desc: grouping: 1 normal weapon, 2 special/legendary/DLC weapon, 3 char-exclusive, 4 char-exclusive XL, 5 char-exclusive top, 6 gag weapons (TV, Watermelon...), 8 armor/accessory, 9 key/special (Gate Key, Famitsu Shield, Axel Gear), 10 consumable

fields.name: dlc_pct_456
fields.desc: 100 normally; 110..150 on crossover/DLC weapons (Prinny Book 110 ... Zetta Sword 150). Probably a percentage multiplier (growth/IW?)

fields.name: char_exclusive
fields.desc: 1 = character-specific weapon (Usalia Fists, Usanagi Sword, Dragzwei, Starfox Cane, Desco Sword, Beryl Staff, ...), 0 otherwise

fields.name: equip_type
fields.desc: equipment class

fields.name: sort_order
fields.desc: list/encyclopedia sort position (mostly equals row index; 0xFFFF = not listed, e.g. Runeblades)

fields.name: unk_45C
fields.desc: 0xFFFF (355 rows) or 8..51; shared by an item and its +10000 copy; consumables: sweets 44, drinks 45, other food 46, EXP potions 49, chara-world items 8. Not a HABIT id (48 missing there). Possibly a use/effect or item-world theme id

fields.name: pad_45E
fields.desc: always 0
